title: Elizondo's book: blocked from a Lockheed program

tellings.quote: Lando's book he specifically mentions how you know they went to locky M to see if they could you know get inside this program

plain: According to Michels, Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon intelligence official who says he ran its UFO study, writes that he and his colleagues went to the defense company Lockheed Martin to try to "get inside" a secret program there and were kept out. Michels cites this from Elizondo's book Imminent, published in 2024. It matters because a Pentagon official being refused entry would suggest a program hidden even from those officially studying UFOs.
